headline: The Vassal Team is happy to announce Vassal {{version}}.
important: Modules saved in {{version_feature}} are not openable by earlier versions of Vassal. We recommend keeping a backup copy of any pre-{{version_feature}} modules you plan to modify in {{version_feature}} until you've verified that everything works to your satisfaction.
Things may be broken which worked previously. If you find a new bug, please report it.

bug_fixes.desc: An unreadable piece definition should not prevent opening the module
Skip an empty slot when looking for an At-Start Stack's top piece
Don't crash the Editor search on a component with an unset field
Stop crashing on a Deck which is not on a Map
Don't open a popup on a PieceSlot with no piece when the press is the popup trigger
Say which part of creating a component failed, and treat a bad attribute value as bad data
Expected response code for updateConnections is now 200, not 201
Ensure that HTTP POSTs are in UTF-8
Don't show empty Turn Window after cancelling from SetDialog
Take a Stack off the map before forgetting which map it was on
Fix NPE when a die face image is missing
Apply every Multi-Piece Editor change to every piece at the same position
Do not let a zoom-to-fit on a boardless map set an infinite zoom
Quote a value ending with a backslash so it keeps its delimiter
Change the Module Manager's tree only on the Event Dispatch Thread
Encode subprocess arguments the ANSI code page cannot carry
Hand out a snapshot of a room's players, not a live view
Bound the apply-on-move key, which can re-enter the trait that moved
Clear the fast-forward flag even when the fast-forward fails
Strip document-structure tags from chat messages
Fix InvalidPathException on non-ASCII filenames under a broken locale
Work around an NPE when contstructing a file dialog on Windows
Don't open saves and logs written by newer major or minor versions, via LaunchRequest

improvements.desc: Let preferences be saved when the file on disk is corrupt
Build the Module Manager window on request, not during class init

bug_fixes.desc: Stop reporting every tiling failure as running out of memory
Only take the panel apart for the map which is in it
Read a field-access method handle as a field descriptor
Use real elapsed time in Swing Timer animations
Let a Region grid without a container be removed and its regions moved
Set the ancestor before building pasted, cloned and copy-dragged component
Fix count and sum expressions when invoked from Report Action trait
Draw nothing, rather than crash, when a board scales to no pixels
Create parent folders when unpacking an HTML Help File
Disable Return to Deck on pieces not on a map
Prevent pieces vanishing when a move is undone

improvements.desc: Don't report bugs for versions of VASL < 6.7.4
Report a class the module does not contain as bad module data
Report a corrupt module prefs file as a read error instead of a bug

bug_fixes.desc: Fix for ObliqueHexGridNumbering
Hide private windows when a game or log is loaded over a running game
Fixed typo in Vassal Reference Manual "Place Marker" text
Deselect pieces when they are shuffled

improvements.desc: Snapshot piece state only when Dynamic Property / Layer handle the keystroke

other.desc: Do not use contractions in messages
Remove use of org.jdesktop.timing and use Swing timers instead

new_features.desc: Compress the saved-game command log with XZ
Allow cannotMove to be set as a DynamicProperty
Add Movement Trail option to keep only last position per location
Multi-Location Command includes the option to sort the order of the commands generated
Add pieceCount to the map auto reporter

bug_fixes.desc: Let JRuby spawn Ghostscript when building the PDF guides
Fix IndexOutOfBoundsException on undo after beginning a new logfile
Fix NPE in ADC2 importer when the module defines no players
Fix NPE when deleting a Toolbar Menu that has no toolbar
Fix NPE in Deck reports for deck commands with no name
Fix Load Log, Fast Forward and Append
Change background of Quickstart message to match UI

improvements.desc: Modify DiceButton to support legacy modules
Stop writing obfuscated data in hex
Make Zone use full qualified path for property container
MoveCameraButton now uses preferred center instead of viewport center
